_readme: PSA 10 prices, by hand. The single store for graded prices on this site:
the set guides read it for their chase cards, and the hunt list reads it
WHY THIS IS MANUAL. The Pokemon TCG API carries TCGplayer prices, and
TCGplayer sells raw cards. Nothing in it knows what a graded copy sold for.
No free feed does. So these numbers only ever come from a person looking at
the PSA price guide or at completed eBay sales, and the site prints them
with the date they were checked, because a graded price with no date is not
KEY FORMAT is <set-id>-<card-number>, matching the ids in sets.json:
"pitch-black-116"  is Mega Darkrai ex, Special Illustration Rare.
Card numbers are what disambiguate; the same Pokemon often appears three
times in one set at three rarities.
Fill in as many or as few as you like. A card with no entry simply shows
its raw price and nothing else, which is the honest default.
